description: Detect and localize object instances in images using bounding boxes.
notes: Object detection is the task scope for YOLO RT-DETR Faster R-CNN RetinaNet SSD and related detector recipes.

description: Assign one or more semantic labels to an image.
notes: Image classification is the task scope for ResNet MobileNetV3 EfficientNet ViT CLIP SwinV2 DINOv2 and related classifier recipes.

description: Answer natural-language questions about image content using multimodal visual-language reasoning.
notes: Visual question answering is the task scope for LLaVA-style large multimodal models that combine a vision encoder with an LLM.
